summary.en: Women's health and neuropsychiatry anchor development, supported by biosimilars and generics. Public materials identify a small set of named clinical candidates amid many unnamed portfolio projects.
summary.zh: 女性健康和神经精神领域是开发的核心,并有生物类似药和仿制药支撑。公开资料中点名的临床候选药物数量不多,另有许多未具名的产品组合项目。

ind.zh: 更年期症状;美国 NDA 已受理

ind.en: Bipolar depression and generalized anxiety disorder
ind.zh: 双相抑郁和广泛性焦虑障碍

watch.en: Vraylar royalties reached HUF189 billion in the first nine months of 2026.
watch.zh: 2026 年前九个月,Vraylar 特许权使用费达到 HUF189 billion。

watch.en: Company strategy explicitly targets managing cariprazine loss-of-exclusivity effects through new CNS assets.
watch.zh: 公司战略明确提出通过新的 CNS 资产来应对 cariprazine 独占期结束 (LOE) 的影响。

watch.en: Estetrol's US application has been accepted; a decision date was not verified.
watch.zh: Estetrol 的美国申请已获受理;未核实决定日期。

watch.en: Nine-month free cash flow before M&A reached HUF223 billion.
watch.zh: 并购前九个月自由现金流达到 HUF223 billion。

gaps: Only three distinct named clinical/registration assets verified in current materials; many pipeline-chart projects are unnamed. No company phase totals used.
RGH-202 registry rendered only a JavaScript shell; its indication, target, modality and origin are null. November presentation identifies Phase 2.
RGH-932 mechanism/modality and estetrol origin were not verified; no future milestone dates established. Source renders the US brand as FYLREY; generic name used.

Required curl -sSIL URL checks were attempted for every cited URL on 2026-11-17, but all returned HTTP 000 / curl error 6 (DNS resolution unavailable in this environment). Browser-observed sources underpin the entries; final HTTP status validation could not be completed.
Original-research landing page is dated March 2025, older than June 2026; named asset stages come from November 2026 presentations.
